name: pv2b-train
architecture: afterstate value MLP: encoder v2 (1,324) -> 256 -> 256 -> 1 (ReLU), sigmoid = win chance after this turn

gate.metric: within-decision: playout win rate of the model's picked candidate minus the served candidate's, over test decisions (24 playouts per candidate)
gate.pass: game-clustered bootstrap 95% lower bound of the gain > 0
gate.reported: oracle-best minus served; share of decisions where the served pick is playout-best; on decisions with both end-now and a city-building candidate, how often the model and the playouts rank the city above ending

integration_if_pass: planner_pv2 (catan_ai.pv_search.PVSearchPlanner) with the exported model: at own-turn build/trade decisions it plays the first move of the candidate whose afterstate the model rates highest; all else served. Standard +.05 screen on tactical/mixed/self, 128 seeds, fresh seeds 2770000/2771000/2772000.
note: Same model, loss, gate and integration as pv2-train, bound to the pv2b data (full position logging). Predeclared before any pv2b data. Predeclared 2026-11-04 with the data config and before any test-split game is read. Model audit fixes: encoder v2 (fix 3/4), counterfactual afterstate targets at the search's own candidates with exploration (fix 1), within-decision gate (fix 2), no separate noisy policy head: the served search proposes and the value decides (fix 5). Epoch chosen by validation loss on the last 150 train games; no other tuning.
